while True:
 log=(out/'build-sequence.log').read_text()
 if 'PASS optimized build and focused checks' in log:break

oldsubject=load(old/'subject.json');assert subject['intinf_sha256']==oldsubject['intinf_sha256'];assert subject['vm_sha256']==oldsubject['vm_sha256']
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))});commands=[]
def run(name,command,cwd=root):
 assert sha('lib/basis/intinf.sml')==subject['intinf_sha256'] and sha('src/elab/elaborate.sml')==subject['elaborate_sha256']
 print('START',name,flush=True);start=time.monotonic()
 with (perf/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:p=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=7200)
 commands.append({'name':name,'command':list(map(str,command)),'cwd':str(cwd),'exit':p.returncode,'seconds':time.monotonic()-start});(perf/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands,indent=2)+'\n')
 if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('FAIL '+name)
 print('PASS',name,flush=True)
# Reuse arithmetic timing only if this compiler recreates EVERY timed current
# bytecode, including the saved-list oracle. The VM binary is identical too.
verified=[];current_compiler=Path('bin/rune').resolve()
for name in ['current-gmp','current-sml','dispatch']:
 destination=perf/'reproduced'/name;destination.mkdir(parents=True)
 for source_command in sorted((oldperf/name).glob('*.command.json')):
  item=load(source_command);argv=item if isinstance(item,list) else item['argv'];cwd=root if isinstance(item,list) else Path(item['cwd'])
  if '-o' not in argv:continue
  executable=Path(argv[0]);executable=executable if executable.is_absolute() else cwd/executable
  if executable.resolve()!=current_compiler:continue
  original=Path(argv[argv.index('-o')+1]);original=original if original.is_absolute() else cwd/original
